[[File:Vanquo.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The mining outpost in 3,964 BBY]]
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], there was an active [[Mining/Legends|mining]] '''outpost''' nestled within the [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] terrain of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vanquo]]. In [[3964 BBY]], fugitive former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and his friends staged a fake [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] attack to clear the outpost of its crew, in order to take all of its supplies. However, shortly after their successful ruse, the Mandalorians [[Battle of Vanquo|invaded]] for real, capturing [[Jarael|one of their number]] and forcing the rest to flee.
